scenes.caption: HUE EATS
scenes.label: 5 DISHES
scenes.narration: What to eat in Hue? Here are the five dishes TikTok loves most, with where they come from, how to eat them, and places rated four and a half stars or more.

scenes.caption: Bun bo Hue
scenes.narration: Dish number one, bun bo. In Hue they simply call it bun bo gio cha, and its origin is only legend. The broth simmers bones with lemongrass and fermented shrimp paste, served with pork knuckle and crab cake. To eat, add chili sate and fresh herbs. Try Sen, Nha An or O Ty.

story.tagline: Locals just call it bun bo gio cha

sections.title: Origin
sections.text: Its origin is only legend; no firm record

sections.title: How it's made
sections.text: Bone broth with lemongrass and shrimp paste · pork knuckle, crab cake, beef shank

sections.title: How to eat
sections.text: Add chili sate and herbs; locals say pick a shop with a big aluminium pot

scenes.caption: Com hen
scenes.narration: Dish number two, com hen, a humble dish tied to Hen Islet in the Perfume River. Cold rice is tossed with stir-fried baby clams, crackling, peanuts and herbs. To eat, mix it all and pour on hot clam broth, for about fifteen thousand dong. Try Han Mac Tu, Ba Den or Huong Xua.

scenes.caption: Banh beo
scenes.narration: Dish number three, banh beo, tiny rice cakes steamed in little saucers, a Hue signature. The batter cooks right in the dish, topped with shrimp floss and scallion oil. To eat, spoon on sweet fish sauce while they're hot. Try Hue Xua, Trung Bo or Quan Ngo.

scenes.caption: Banh nam & banh loc
scenes.narration: Dish number four, banh nam and banh loc. Legend says banh nam began in Nam Pho village near Hue. Nam is a thin rice cake wrapped in banana leaf, while banh loc is clear tapioca dough with shrimp and pork. To eat, dip in chili fish sauce. Try Huong Cau, Rin or Hue Cuisine.

scenes.caption: Che Hue
scenes.narration: Dish number five, che, Hue's sweet soups, famous for royal-style lotus seed che. There's even che with tapioca balls wrapped around roast pork, the most debated dish on TikTok. To eat, order a tray of several kinds. Try Che Thanh, Ngoc Che Buoi or Ong Lac.

scenes.caption: Eat your way through Hue
scenes.narration: Hue food runs spicy and salty, so ask for less chili if you need to. Famous spots under four and a half stars are in the description. Save it!
